assessment.description: Confirm the subscribed edition, limits, add-ons and seat entitlements before making a cost or availability claim.
assessment.root_cause_hypothesis: Confirm the subscribed edition, limits, add-ons and seat entitlements before making a cost or availability claim.
proposed_improvement: Confirm current product, edition, region, seats, add-ons, usage quotas and renewal terms.
Compare configuring the existing plan, buying an add-on, integrating a tool or building a workflow.
Estimate total cost of ownership using actual vendor quotes and internal effort.
assessment.recommended_automation: Do not build a workaround before confirming whether the capability is already licensed.
assessment.recommended_integration: Consider only after native entitlement and configuration are checked.
assessment.implementation_complexity: Low for entitlement check; financial impact requires quote and usage context
assessment.expected_business_benefits: Avoids paying for duplicate functionality and supports a defensible buy/configure/build choice.
risks_and_limitations: Plan names and entitlements change; undocumented assumptions can invalidate a comparison.
Vendor list price may differ from contracted pricing.
assessment.measurement_plan: Record a pre-intervention baseline using the same population, metric definition and time window. After the pilot, compare a like-for-like period or a suitable holdout; disclose seasonality and other changes. No impact percentage is assumed.
assessment.recommended_next_step: Validate the actual plan, configuration, data mapping and workflow against the linked source before implementation.
